system_sentence: Wave is a local-first, Mac-native text-based audio editor. This map spans three surfaces — Editor, Projects, and Settings/Models — whose individual structural sentences are recorded in STATEFUL.md; the Editor's anchors the set: a persistent, non-destructive editing session layering a revisable queue of time-range cuts over immutable transcribed audio, reconciled from disk on each re-entry and resolved into new audio only at export.

states.name: Editor idle, ready
states.description: Transcript rendered, audio loaded, paused at 0, no selection, no edits.

states.name: Playing with word highlight
states.description: Playhead advancing; active word located by binary search and highlighted via direct DOM.

states.name: Editing session with a cut queue
states.description: A non-empty revisable queue of cuts over the recording, persisted to edits.json.

reentry_variants.context: Q1 — return after time has passed
reentry_variants.specification: Cut queue restored from edits.json (editsLoadedRef guard); playhead resets to 0. Reload assumes the transcript is byte-identical to the one the indices were written against — see Q4.

reentry_variants.context: Q2 — notification / deep link / different device
reentry_variants.specification: Not applicable: local single-window desktop app.

reentry_variants.context: Q3 — arrive without the preceding state
reentry_variants.specification: Non-ready projects show a hint; a ready project with zero transcript words is not distinguished (gap ed-g2).

Re-transcription rewrites transcript.json while edits.json keeps positional indices; nothing revalidates (gap ed-g1). Fingerprint edits against the transcript; invalidate or remap on mismatch and notify.
Corrupt edits.json (crash mid-save) is silently discarded by the start-fresh catch; back it up and notify instead.

states.name: Non-text region cut
states.description: A cut of audio with no transcript word attached (breath, pause, room tone), spliced gently at export.

states.name: Exporting (busy)
states.description: Transcript or full-fidelity audio export in progress.

states.name: Stale edit indices after re-transcription
states.description: Positional cut indices in edits.json have no link to the transcript version; re-transcription silently re-points them (src/pages/EditorPage.tsx:275).

states.name: Transcript present but zero words
states.description: Non-speech/silent/wrong-language audio yields words:[] at status Ready; blank editor over real audio (TranscriptEditor.tsx:16; EditorPage.tsx:136).

states.name: All audio unavailable
states.description: Original undecodable and 16 kHz WAV missing; fallback ends at console.warn (EditorPage.tsx:342); waveform never loads, no error surface.

states.name: Transcript-export failure
states.description: Caught to console.error only (InspectorPanel.tsx:72); unlike audio export, no inline surface.

states.name: Interaction before audio decodes
states.description: waveLoading tracked but clicks/keys are live during decode; a seek/cut can land before durationMs is known.

states.name: edits.json save failure
states.description: Save rejection swallowed at console.warn (EditorPage.tsx:374); cuts silently unpersisted.
states.scope_note: Add a persistent 'changes not saved' indicator; the data model is already adequate.

states.name: All audio deleted (empty export)
states.description: Cutting every word + range produces a near-empty WAV with no floor or warning.
states.scope_note: Disable/confirm export when no audio survives; reflect survivor length in the button.

states.name: Screen-reader / keyboard rendering
states.description: Waveform, ruler and word-track are aria-hidden; editing is pointer-only.
states.scope_note: Word nodes already carry data-* timing attrs; an a11y layer can build on them.

states.name: External change to on-disk transcript/audio
states.description: No detection; the editor trusts on-disk files at mount.
states.scope_note: Becomes in-scope with any sync/multi-device story (see ed-g1).

states.name: Very long recording in memory
states.description: splice loads the entire file to RAM (~230 MB/60 min).
states.scope_note: Streaming splice; in-scope for long-form podcasts.

states.name: Empty library
states.description: No projects — idle-waveform empty state with New Project CTA.

states.name: Library listed
states.description: Project cards in a grid, sorted by created_at desc.

states.name: Importing with progress
states.description: Amber progress bar; decode → resample → 16 kHz WAV in the background.

states.name: Transcribing
states.description: Teal progress bar; local Whisper running.

reentry_variants.context: Q1 — return after time has passed
reentry_variants.specification: Returning after quitting mid-transcription finds a permanently-Transcribing card; list_projects repairs stale Importing only (gap pr-g1).
The selected model deleted mid-run causes failure with no in-flight recovery.
A partial transcript.json from a crashed run is not validated on next open (ties ed-g1).

states.name: Import/transcribe error surfaced on card
states.description: Error status with message rendered on the card (useProjects.ts:154).

states.name: App quit mid-transcription
states.description: list_projects repairs stale Importing only (src-tauri/src/projects.rs:202); a project left Transcribing stays stuck with a spinner and no retry path.

states.name: list_projects failure renders as empty
states.description: Caught to console.error, loading=false (useProjects.ts:44) → the 'No projects yet' empty state (ProjectsPage.tsx:379), identical to a genuinely empty library.

states.name: Corrupt project.json vanishes
states.description: read_project returns None on parse failure (projects.rs:56); list_projects silently continues (:199) and the project disappears.

states.name: Project-create kickoff failure
states.description: createProject has no try/catch (useProjects.ts:51); a throw propagates through handleCreate with no catch (ProjectsPage.tsx:205), no feedback.

states.name: Silent delete failure
states.description: deleteProject re-throws but handleConfirmDelete's finally closes the modal with no error (useProjects.ts:97; ProjectsPage.tsx:328); project remains.
states.scope_note: Delete must not report success it didn't achieve; keep the row and surface the error.

states.name: Selected model deleted before transcribe
states.description: Auto-transcribe uses selectedModelId (App.tsx:62); if that model was deleted, transcription errors. Inherits cross-cutting dangling selection.
states.scope_note: Re-validate the model exists before kicking off auto-transcription.

states.name: Large library (no virtualization)
states.description: All cards rendered (ProjectsPage.tsx:391); fine at small N.
states.scope_note: In-scope when libraries grow to hundreds of projects.

states.name: Model catalogue listed
states.description: Six model cards with disk-derived status.

states.name: Downloading with progress
states.description: Live bytes/speed/ETA; resumable and cancellable. Exemplary re-entry handling.

reentry_variants.context: Q1 — return after time has passed
reentry_variants.specification: Quit mid-download leaves a .part; relaunch derives Partial + Resume from disk (models.rs:285).
Connection loss keeps .part; Retry resumes via a Range request (models.rs:302).

states.name: Partial download (resume available)
states.description: .part on disk after cancel/interrupt; Resume button + bytes-so-far.

states.name: Model ready
states.description: .bin present; size shown, Delete + Use-for-transcription controls.

states.name: Active model selected
states.description: selectedModelId persisted to settings.json; Active-model badge.

states.name: No model-file integrity check
states.description: Only byte size is verified (models.rs:405); a corrupt-but-complete file is marked Ready and fails later at load (transcription.rs:297).

states.name: Dangling active-model selection after delete
states.description: Deleting the active model doesn't clear selectedModelId (useModels.ts:95; auto-select only when empty, App.tsx:37); next transcribe fails.

states.name: Finalize with no Content-Length
states.description: Size check skipped when content_length==0 (models.rs:400) and .part renamed regardless (:413); a truncated file can finalize as Ready.

states.name: Silent model-delete failure
states.description: deleteModel logs to console.error only (useModels.ts:99).
states.scope_note: Delete UI must not imply a success that didn't happen.

states.name: Download progress not announced
states.description: ProgressBar hideLabel (SettingsPage.tsx:143); no live-region for assistive tech.
states.scope_note: The card structure already supports a live-region hook.
